name: New Bedford
note_en: Ishmael visits the city before taking ship for Nantucket; the marker represents the city as a whole.
note: 以实玛利去楠塔基特搭船之前来到这座城市；标记代表整座城市。

name: Nantucket
note_en: Melville describes the island as a remote sandy outpost; the marker represents the island as a whole.
note: 梅尔维尔将这座岛描写为偏远的沙地前哨；标记代表全岛。

name: Walden Pond
note_en: Thoreau describes the pond and his life beside it; the marker represents the pond, not an exact cabin location.
note: 梭罗描写这座湖泊以及湖畔生活；标记代表湖泊，并非木屋的精确位置。

name: Washington, D.C.
note_en: Whitman records visiting wartime hospitals across the city; this is a city-wide marker.
note: 惠特曼记录了在全城探望战时医院的经历；此标记代表整座城市。

name: Falmouth
note_en: Whitman departs from the military camp at Falmouth with wounded soldiers; the marker represents the town.
note: 惠特曼与伤兵一起离开法尔茅斯的军营；标记代表城镇。

name: Camden
note_en: Whitman returns to Camden and describes a night crossing of the Delaware; the city marker is not a ferry position.
note: 惠特曼返回卡姆登，描写夜渡特拉华河的景象；城市标记并非渡轮所在位置。

name: Pittsburgh
note_en: Whitman describes the industrial city during his 1879 railway journey; the marker represents the city.
note: 惠特曼在一八七九年的铁路旅途中描写这座工业城市；标记代表全城。

name: Northern Panhandle, represented at Weirton
name_zh: 西弗吉尼亚北部狭长地带 · 魏尔顿代表点
note_en: The passage concerns the Northern Panhandle as a region. Weirton supplies a representative inland point, not a claimed stop or exact railway alignment.
note: 摘句描写北部狭长地带这一地区。魏尔顿提供内陆代表点，不表示作者在此停留或铁路的精确位置。

name: Orchard House
note_en: Alcott wrote and set Little Women at Orchard House; the fictional March family room is not a measured description of the surviving interior.
note: 奥尔科特在果园居写作《小妇人》，并以此为故事背景；马奇家的虚构房间并非现存室内的实测描写。

name: Great Neck
note_en: Great Neck is associated with the novel’s West Egg; this marker represents the community, not Gatsby’s fictional mansion.
note: 大颈镇与小说中的西卵相对应；此标记代表社区，而非盖茨比虚构的豪宅。

name: The Plaza Hotel
note_en: Jordan tells Nick about Daisy and Gatsby while they sit in the hotel’s tea garden.
note: 乔丹在饭店茶园里向尼克讲述黛西与盖茨比的往事。

name: Sullivan’s Island
note_en: Poe places Legrand’s retreat on this island; the marker represents the island, not the fictional hut.
note: 坡将勒格朗的隐居处设在这座岛上；标记代表岛屿，而非虚构的小屋。

name: Charleston
note_en: The narrator lives in Charleston and travels to visit Legrand; this is a city-wide marker.
note: 叙述者住在查尔斯顿，并从那里前往勒格朗的住处；此标记代表全城。

name: Wilmington
note_en: The fictional Wellington reworks Wilmington and the white-supremacist violence of 1898; the marker represents the city.
note: 虚构的威灵顿以威尔明顿及一八九八年的白人至上主义暴力事件为基础；标记代表全城。

name: Clyde
note_en: Anderson’s childhood town helped shape fictional Winesburg; the marker is not the separate real town named Winesburg.
note: 安德森童年居住的城镇启发了虚构的温斯堡；此标记并非另一座真实存在的同名城镇。

name: Franconia
note_en: The title poem remembers election results displayed at a film screening in Franconia; the marker represents the town.
note: 标题诗回忆弗兰科尼亚一次电影放映中公布选举结果的情景；标记代表城镇。

name: Georgetown
note_en: Townsend’s fictionalized account sends Patty Cannon to jail here; the marker represents the town, not a surviving jail.
note: 汤森的小说化叙述写到帕蒂·坎农被押往这里的监狱；标记代表城镇，并非现存监狱。

name: Laurel
note_en: Laurel on Broad Creek is named in directions given to Mary; the marker represents the town.
note: 人物为玛丽指路时提到布罗德溪畔的劳雷尔；标记代表城镇。

name: Princess Anne
note_en: The novel opens with the town’s courts, churches and social hierarchy; the marker represents the town.
note: 小说开篇描写城镇的法院、教堂及社会等级；标记代表城镇。

name: Dover
note_en: Dover is the destination Vesta gives Samson; the marker represents the town as a whole.
note: 维斯塔指定多佛为萨姆森的目的地；标记代表整座城镇。

name: Harriet Beecher Stowe House, Hartford
name_zh: 哈特福德 · 哈丽特·比彻·斯托故居
note_en: Harriet Beecher Stowe lived here from 1873 until her death in 1896. Her later home is now a public house museum at the Stowe Center for Literary Activism; Uncle Tom’s Cabin had been published in 1852, before she lived here.
note: 哈丽特·比彻·斯托从一八七三年起住在这里，直至一八九六年去世。这座晚年故居如今是斯托文学行动中心对公众开放的故居博物馆；《汤姆叔叔的小屋》早在一八五二年便已出版，并非在此写成。

name: Harriet Beecher Stowe House, Brunswick
name_zh: 布伦斯威克 · 哈丽特·比彻·斯托故居
note_en: Harriet Beecher Stowe and her family rented this house from 1850 to 1852, when she wrote Uncle Tom’s Cabin. It now belongs to Bowdoin College and contains faculty offices; scheduled public access is limited to Harriet’s Writing Room. The house is not a setting of the novel.
note: 哈丽特·比彻·斯托与家人于一八五〇至一八五二年租住此屋，其间写作《汤姆叔叔的小屋》。房屋现属鲍登学院，内设教师办公室；公众只能按开放安排参观哈丽特写作室。这里并非小说的故事地点。

name: Providence Athenaeum
name_zh: 普罗维登斯雅典娜图书馆
note_en: Edgar Allan Poe and Sarah Helen Whitman visited this library during their 1848 courtship; she ended their relationship here on December 23. It remains a member-supported library open to visitors. Poe did not live here, and The Gold-Bug is not set here.
note: 埃德加·爱伦·坡与莎拉·海伦·惠特曼在一八四八年交往期间到访这座图书馆；十二月二十三日，她在这里结束了两人的关系。这里如今仍是向访客开放的会员制图书馆。坡并未居住于此，《金甲虫》的故事也不发生在这里。

name: Robert Frost Stone House Museum
name_zh: 沙夫茨伯里 · 罗伯特·弗罗斯特石屋博物馆
note_en: Robert Frost lived here from 1920 to 1929 and wrote poems collected in New Hampshire, including Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening. The house is now a public museum owned by Bennington College; its position does not identify the poem’s unnamed woods.
note: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特于一九二〇至一九二九年居住在此，写下后来收入《新罕布什尔》的诗篇，其中包括《雪夜林边小驻》。这里如今是本宁顿学院所属、对公众开放的博物馆；故居位置不能用于确定诗中未具名的树林。
